agent_file_proposals_file_key.name: agent_file_proposals_file_key
agent_file_proposals_file_key.value: "file_key" = 'workflow' OR ("file_key" = 'agents_block' OR ("file_key" GLOB 'skill:?*' AND length("file_key") <= 66 AND substr("file_key", 7) NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'))

agent_file_proposals_content.name: agent_file_proposals_content
agent_file_proposals_content.value: CASE WHEN "file_key" = 'workflow' THEN length("content") <= 10000 ELSE length("content") BETWEEN 1 AND 50000 END

agent_files_key.name: agent_files_key
agent_files_key.value: "key" = 'agents_block' OR "key" = 'guide:onboarding' OR ("key" GLOB 'skill:?*' AND length("key") <= 66 AND substr("key", 7) NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*')

commits_sha.name: commits_sha
commits_sha.value: length("sha") BETWEEN 7 AND 40 AND lower("sha") NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

drift_file_key.name: drift_file_key
drift_file_key.value: "file_key" IN ('connection', 'script:docket-wait.sh', 'script:docket-wait.ps1') OR ("file_key" = 'agents_block' OR ("file_key" GLOB 'skill:?*' AND length("file_key") <= 66 AND substr("file_key", 7) NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'))

drift_local_sha256.name: drift_local_sha256
drift_local_sha256.value: CASE WHEN "change" = 'missing' THEN "local_sha256" IS NULL ELSE "local_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND length("local_sha256") = 64 END

installs_path.name: installs_path
installs_path.value: "path" IS NULL OR length("path") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

installs_token.name: installs_token
installs_token.value: ("token_sha256" IS NULL) = ("token_expires_at" IS NULL) AND ("method" = 'command' OR "token_sha256" IS NULL)

instruction_reports_location.name: instruction_reports_location
instruction_reports_location.value: "location" IS NULL OR length("location") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

labels_name_format.name: labels_name_format
labels_name_format.value: length("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 40 AND "name" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

onboarding_sessions_summary.name: onboarding_sessions_summary
onboarding_sessions_summary.value: CASE WHEN "state" = 'in_progress' THEN "summary" IS NULL ELSE "summary" IS NOT NULL AND length("summary") BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 END

projects_key_format.name: projects_key_format
projects_key_format.value: length("key") BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND "key" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*'

runs_external.name: runs_external
runs_external.value: "external" IS NULL OR length(CAST("external" AS BLOB)) <= 2048

shared_parts_key.name: shared_parts_key
shared_parts_key.value: length("key") BETWEEN 3 AND 200 AND substr("key", 1, length("kind") + 1) = "kind" || ':' AND length("key") > length("kind") + 1
